description: This file defines the EcrClient class for interacting with Amazon EC2 Container Registry (ECR) service, including method signatures for various ECR operations.

classes.name: EcrClient
classes.description: Client class for Amazon ECR service, extending AwsClient, with methods for ECR operations.

methods.name: batchCheckLayerAvailability
methods.description: Checks the availability of image layers in batch.

methods.name: batchGetImage
methods.description: Retrieves details of images in batch.

methods.name: putImage
methods.description: Pushes an image to a repository.
